content:
Last week, Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that its former employee "stole trade secrets for the benefit of OpenAI."

In the course of the litigation, Apple is reported to have sent letters directly to dozens of former employees who now work at OpenAI.

According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued evidence preservation letters to approximately 40 former employees.

An evidence preservation letter is a formal written notice sent to an individual or organisation, requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence that may be relevant to a legal dispute. Such letters typically spell out specifically what must be preserved.

The move comes amid Apple's suspicion that the theft of trade secrets may extend beyond the individuals named in the complaint filed last week.

As a reminder, Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, along with former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.
